$Comment: Places the Thumper deployable at the player's own position (OriginSource Entity with a zero Offset is the feet; the player is the owner, which Worms reads). A deployable of type Aoe with DamageAmount 0 and no effects does nothing but stand: no HitboxCollisionConfig, so it never blocks or pushes the player; Invulnerable; LiveDuration 0 is no despawn timer (the engine adds one only above 0). Model: Arrakis_Thumper (the vanilla torch model and texture, re-encoded). MaxLiveCount and LiveDuration are overwritten at server start from MaxLivePerPlayer and MaxLiveSeconds in the Thumper config.
